Their innovations – born of passion and practical ingenuity – shaped not just Chicago, but the modern world.
Our story is your story Our early stage, growth stage and corporate innovators are the center of our gravity.
Our community’s impact resonates throughout Chicago and beyond.

350 Mentors 100 Partners 650+ Alumni 4 Venture Capital Firms 7 Partner Universities Inspire, equip, support We exist to create the experiences and space that early stage, growth stage, and corporate innovators need while they build extraordinary businesses.
These values make up the core of who we are, and we are proud to have received two awards from UBI Global: the World #1 Top Business Incubator and the Most Promising Women Founders Incubator.

The diversity and density of our community creates the conditions for both calculated and fortunate collisions of success between early stage, growth stage, corporate innovators, and community members.
